name: FlipFilterGrid
job: Filter chips that sort a set of cards by category while the cards glide to their new places instead of jumping
visitor_action: click/tap one or more chips; Esc clears
motion: cards translate to new positions with spring, hidden ones shrink and fade (reduced-motion: instant filter)
provenance: original, built from a concept description
art_direction: Market stall sort: butter-cream ground, tomato-red active chips, tidy white cards with thin hairline borders, friendly rounded sans
notes: Not yet seen rendered (screenshots deferred to QA). Risks to check: staggered spring choreography timing, featured 2x2 card resizing mid-flight, and caption-height measurement with worst-case titles at 375.
